title: Into the Edge: from palm to atom
description:
An interactive, browser-based zoom from a gold-coated drill bit in the palm of a hand down to the atoms of its PVD coating, from 20 cm to 5 Å. Every level has a plain-language caption, a familiar object drawn at true scale for comparison and a card for researchers with the method used at that scale and an open question. The engine is journey-agnostic: a new zoom for another material is one config file plus texts.

Live site: peretyaginmstu-jpg.github.io/into-the-edge. Code under MIT, texts and illustrations under CC BY 4.0.
